title: Session-capture raw slot (slot.json)
description: session-capture-contract.md §3.1 / ADR-0044 §4. The fixed-location rolling turn-complete checkpoint written by the hook-fired publisher (context.mjs publish-session). Fields are labeled by observer: publisher-observed git facts are probed by the publisher itself under §6's bounded/degradable rules; sensor-relayed fields (host, session_id, repo_recent_terminal_evidence) arrive as validated argv from the attention Stop sensor and are never publisher observations. Published slot-first-then-entry; entry.json is the commit record (§7) — a fingerprint mismatch between the two marks an incomplete generation that the next publisher run republishes.

origin.description: Producing path. The auto slot knows only the Stop-hook origin; the enum (not a boolean) leaves room for future origins without a schema break (the notify_channel shape rationale).

summary_source.description: Channel honesty (ADR-0044 §1): staged-note asserts only that an explicit local `context note` invocation staged the folded content — never authorship. structural = no note folded.

host.description: Sensor-relayed. v1 fires only on the Claude limb (ADR-0044 §8), but the artifact is host-neutral by contract.

session_id.description: Sensor-relayed, clamped; null when the hook payload carried none.

repo_recent_terminal_evidence.description: Sensor-relayed repo-level last-observed evidence (§5.3). Recorded, never suppressed on — entry-side arbitration weighs it. An absent flag is recorded as none.

repo_root.description: Publisher-observed repo root (settlement (a): a Tier-1 fact recorded in the RAW slot for diagnosis; deliberately ABSENT from entry.json to keep the injected-surface projection path-free).

branch.description: Publisher-observed; null on detached HEAD (§6 per-field degradation).

head_short.description: Publisher-observed; null on unborn HEAD or probe degradation.

dirty_count.description: Publisher-observed dirty-file count; null when the porcelain probe overflowed or errored.

status_digest.description: sha256 hex of the bounded porcelain v1 -z output (§6); null when unavailable — a null digest is 'unknown', never 'clean'.

note.description: The folded note verbatim WITH its staging metadata (ADR-0044 §6) so a consumer can weigh a note staged on another branch or hours earlier; null when no note is inside the fold window. Shape mirrors runtime-session-note-1.0 minus the schema id.

fingerprint.description: fp1: + sha256 of the §5 canonical fingerprint input. Identical in slot.json and entry.json within one committed generation; a mismatch marks a mixed generation (§7).
